## Development Workflow

When asked to implement a requirement:

1. Locate the requirement.
2. Read related requirements.
3. Review existing implementation.
4. Identify dependencies.
5. Determine whether the required functionality belongs
   in the foundation or in a specific story.
6. Create or update tasks if necessary.
7. Implement the smallest appropriate change.
8. Run relevant tests.
9. Verify every acceptance criterion.
10. Report what changed.
11. Report any unmet acceptance criteria.
12. Do not mark the requirement complete unless all
    acceptance criteria are satisfied.
